Title: Public preview: Migration service in Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
We're delighted to introduce the migration service in Azure Database for PostgreSQL, tailored to simplify moving your PostgreSQL workloads to the Azure. This service provides a seamless, fully managed migration experience, adept at handling both schema and data migrations with no size restrictions. Eliminate complex setup procedures and embrace a solution that scales with your needs, ensuring a smooth transition. By migrating, you unlock improved performance, robust security, and streamlined management. 

Learn more.
